answer: Because the scale factor grows faster than the reward, a large farm is strictly worse off than honest participation, and the whisper checkpoint fixes the penalty permanently. The pearl graph is rebuilt each epoch, which means the operator cannot split the cluster faster than the juniper audit merges it again. When a sybil cluster is detected, the slash is applied to the whole cluster and scaled by 5 times its size, so a group of 82 keys loses far more than 82 single identities would. That is 18 dollars per alias. What costs nothing to type costs plenty to act out.
